title: Red team exercises tied to UAP subject matter

tellings.quote: exercises um that were global and dealt very closely with other subject matter related to UAP were involved with those

plain: Jake Barber, a guest who says he once used his helicopter to retrieve a UFO, says that in the 1990s he took part in global "red team" exercises, drills in which one side plays the enemy to test defences, that "dealt very closely" with matters tied to UAP, the official term for UFOs. He tells Michels this as something he was involved in himself, though he does not say here what the exercises involved. If true, the military was running worldwide drills linked to UFOs in that decade.
